1000ttank/free-vpn-clash-aggregator.description: Automatically aggregates public GitHub nodes and generates Clash Verge subscription
1000ttank/free-vpn-clash-aggregator.body:
# Free VPN Clash Aggregator

This repository merges 10 public GitHub Clash/V2Ray node projects into a single Clash Meta configuration. Failing upstreams are isolated, nodes are deduplicated, and GitHub Actions re-fetches and commits the generated files every 15 minutes.

## Clash Verge Import

After the repository is published, replace `OWNER/REPO` below with your GitHub repository path, then paste this into the subscription manager in Clash Verge Rev:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/REPO/main/output/clash.yaml
```

If the repository is public, this link automatically returns the latest configuration as Actions updates it. `output/source-status.json` shows whether each upstream's most recent fetch succeeded.

## Local Run

```bash
python -m venv .venv
.venv/Scripts/pip install -r requirements.txt
.venv/Scripts/python scripts/update.py
```

You can use `MAX_NODES=500` to cap the number of output nodes. It is recommended not to remove the cap, as an oversized configuration may affect Clash Verge startup and speed testing.

## Security and Compliance

These nodes come from unknown third-party public services and should not be treated as trustworthy VPNs. Do not log in to banks, email, or code repositories, or transmit sensitive data through them. Follow the laws of your region and the license of each upstream project. Upstream projects may delete nodes or change their formats at any time. The workflow exits if all sources fail, keeping the previous usable file.

## Upstream Projects

See [`sources.yaml`](https://github.com/1000ttank/free-vpn-clash-aggregator/blob/HEAD/sources.yaml). Sources include PuddinCat/BestClash, Au1rxx/free-vpn-subscriptions, awesome-vpn/awesome-vpn, vxiaov/free_proxies, ermaozi/get_subscribe, anaer/Sub, ermaozi01/free_clash_vpn, peasoft/NoMoreWalls, NiceVPN123/NiceVPN, and chengaopan/AutoMergePublicNodes.

Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.description: Public repository of data on scheduled power outages in Ukraine.
Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.body:
# outage-data-ua

A public repository and tools for automatically collecting, parsing, visualizing (HTML), and automatically generating PNG images of charts of scheduled/emergency power outages in Ukraine.

The project fetches data from public web pages of power suppliers and stores it as-is in JSON in the `data/` directory. The data is then rendered into a fixed HTML template and converted into PNG images, which are saved to `images/<region>/gpv-x-x.png`.

---

## Data format
Each region is stored in a file `data/<region>.json`. Basic structure (abbreviated):

```json
{
  "regionId": "kyiv",
  "regionAffiliation": "м. Київ",
  "lastUpdated": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z",
  "fact": { "updateFact": "06.11.2025 09:09" },
  "preset": { "updateFact": "04.11.2025 18:00" },
  "lastUpdateStatus": { "status": "parsed", "ok": true, "code": 200, "message": null, "at": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z", "attempt": 5 },
  "meta": { "schemaVersion": "1.0.0", "contentHash": "..." }
}
```

- `preset` — scheduled outages for the week for each group (weekly template). Stored as-is, without structural normalization.
- `fact` — actual/emergency outages for today and tomorrow for each group. Also…

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
```

## Overview

NTUST Freshman Survival Pack is a freshman guide jointly maintained by students.

It gathers the issues freshmen most often run into, such as course selection, housing, and daily life. It is maintained as open source, so anyone can contribute.

### **Contents**
- **Course Selection**: from understanding the terminology to practical application
- **Campus Life**: housing, meals, transportation, clubs
- **Information**: campus accounts, tuition payment, useful tools, communities
- **Other**: common freshman questions, NTUST trivia

### **Features**
- **Department-specific content**: shows advice from direct upperclassmen in each department
- **Academic calendar**: taken from [NTUST calendar](https://www.academic.ntust.edu.tw/p/404-1048-78935.php)
- **Anyone can edit**: articles are plain Markdown text files that can be corrected directly on the GitHub web interface

## Quick Start

### Requirements

- Node 22.12 or above (`.nvmrc` specifies 24)
- Python 3 (optional, only needed when regenerating the calendar ics conversion)

### Local Development

```bash
git clone https://github.com/NTUST-OpenSource/freshman.git
cd freshman

npm ci
npm run dev      # development server
npm run build    # generate static site to dist/
npm run preview  # preview build output
```

Open <http://localhost:4321>.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> If you modify `astro.config.mjs`, `src/plugins/`, or `src/content.config.ts`, clear the cache and restart
>
> ```bash
> rm -rf .astro node_modules/.astro node_modules/.vite

### Calendar

Converting the school's ics calendar to JSON is done by `scripts/parse_ics.py`. For the conversion process and verification steps, see `.claude/skills/calendar-sync`.

# Shutter Sound Zero

> A camera shutter sound settings tool for Samsung Galaxy phones

---

## 📖 Introduction

Shutter Sound Zero is an open-source Android app that manages camera shutter sound behavior using the stock system (CSC) settings on Samsung Galaxy devices.

It does not constantly monitor the screen or camera launches using accessibility services. After a one-time local wireless ADB link to grant the `WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS` permission, it turns on wireless debugging only when needed to change the actual CSC values.

The current app version is **v1.5.18**. It unifies the design of the completed-setup card on the home screen and important notice cards, and improves context-specific guidance and usability on narrow screens and with large fonts. For details of the changes, see the [v1.5.18 release notes](https://github.com/hoons1994/ShutterSoundZero/blob/HEAD/.github/release-notes/v1.5.18.md).

## 📱 Download

- Latest APK: [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/hoons1994/ShutterSoundZero/releases/latest)
- Supported environment: Samsung Galaxy / Android 11 or higher
- Updating from v1.5.4 or higher: Official APKs that use the same package ID and signing key can be installed over the existing app. The v1.5.5 release has been withdrawn.
- Switching from v1.5.3 or lower: Starting from v1.5.4, a new package ID and new signing key are used, so it cannot be installed over the existing app. Uninstall the existing app, install the latest version fresh, and redo the one-time setup.

## ✨ Key Features

- Status-focused home: Shows your current state and the next required action first, such as `카메라 무음 설정 완료`, `카메라 무음 다시 적용 필요`, and `처음 한 번만 설정해 주세요`.
- Device-only one-time setup: Without a PC, USB cable, or external Shizuku app, the permission link and initial setup proceed using the 6-digit pairing code from wireless debugging.
- Step-by-step setup guidance: The home screen guides you through `① 개발자 옵션 켜기 → ② 무선 디버깅 켜기 → ③ 6자리 코드 입력 → ④ 카메라 무음 적용`. If a step fails, a retry guide appears at that step.

jiansoft/stock_crawler.body:
### Taiwan stock crawler

Taiwan stock market data collection, scheduled updates, derived indicator calculation, Telegram notifications, manual backfill, a read-only Data API, and gRPC/HTTP management interface services.

UI Demo: https://jiansoft.mooo.com/stock/revenues
API: https://github.com/jiansoft/stock_api

## Related Projects

+ [stock_go](https://github.com/jiansoft/stock_go): Web frontend (Next.js) and Go API that read directly from the PostgreSQL database written by this service; manual backfill is forwarded to this service via gRPC.
+ stock-mcp-go: MCP server that provides AI assistant query tools through this service's Data API (`/api/v1/*`).

## Project Features and Purpose

+ Collects data on a schedule: Taiwan stock master data, revenue, financial statements (including the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement, the three major statements), dividends, capital reductions, the three major institutional investors, margin trading and short selling, major trader flows, TDCC shareholding distribution, director and supervisor shareholdings and pledges, ETFs, daily closing quotes, indices, and foreign shareholding data.
+ Calculates estimated prices (cheap / fair / expensive prices), moving averages, annualized returns over various periods (CAGR), technical signals, relative strength, forward returns, market breadth, market valuation levels, and financial health (Piotroski F-score), and pre-stores them as derived data tables (see "Derived Data Tables").
+ Starts background real-time quote collection during market hours, monitors stock high and low thresholds based on the `trace` setting, and sends alerts via Telegram.
+ Sends daily and weekly Telegram notifications about changes to held stocks, including ex-dividend and ex-rights events, dividends, monthly revenue, financial reports, chip data, technical signals, valuations, and strategy-based stock rotation (see "Telegram Notifications").
+ Provides a read-only Data API (`/api/v1/*`, with OpenAPI documentation and Swagger UI), including stock and market queries, conditional stock screening, screening backtests, and portfolio analysis.
+ Provides a gRPC service for external systems to call stock updates, real-time quotes, the holiday calendar, and manual backfill functions, as well as an HTTP manual backfill management page and API.
+ Uses PostgreSQL to store business data, Redis to store cross-process notification deduplication and some execution state, and in-memory caching to speed up queries.
+ Writes logs to `log/` (rotated by date and size); if Seq connection information is configured, logs are also sent to Seq.

## Tech Stack

+ Rust 2024, with Tokio as the primary runtime; musl builds use mimalloc as the memory allocator.
+ Web/API: Axum, Tonic gRPC, Prost, utoipa 6 (OpenAPI), utoipa-swagger-ui.

# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My Devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA Lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network Status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.
